title: Mind lamp turns green during the episode

tellings.quote: So, when you multiply these probabilities, you get a 2% chance that we got green on the first try within the first 30 seconds of trying.

plain: During a 2021 episode about the CIA's psychic spy programme, a lamp meant to respond to people's minds turned green on the first try, within the first 30 seconds, and Michels works out the odds of that at about 2%. He tells this himself and cites a researcher named Herb Metts. If it holds up, it would hint that thought alone can nudge a machine.
